thread:
micah: Seeing duplicate webhook deliveries from onboarding sampleapp when clients hit 429 while token is rotating. repro: generate -> 429 (no Retry-After) -> SDK refresh -> immediate retry -> server accepts both -> two webhooks.
hana: can you paste the minimal logs? wondering if client re-sent identical body or server replayed.
micah: logs show identical body hash and two accepts. snippet: `OUT POST /v1/generate id=req-xx hash=ab12` -> `IN 429` -> `sdk.auth.refresh()` -> `OUT POST /v1/generate id=req-xx hash=ab12` -> `IN 200 id=g1`. webhook also got g2 ~140ms later.
rui: we usually tell users to set Idempotency-Key, but onboarding sampleapp deliberately left it out to keep the example tiny. that causes surprises. could we offer an SDK feature to make idempotency easier?
hana: what are you thinking?
rui: two parts: short-term SDK mitigations + a medium-term "signed idempotency" feature. Short-term: add small default post-refresh jitter, telemetry event for post-refresh retries, and an opt-in transient in-memory dedupe. Medium-term: SDK can generate a cryptographically signed idempotency token (HMAC over body-hash + timestamp) that server can verify to globally dedupe even across token refresh storms.
micah: signed idempotency sounds novel. server verifies signature and enforces TTL so replay outside window is rejected. pros: no huge caches. cons: needs server verifier + key management.
hana: agree. could be hosted-only initially; private customers would need to upload a public key or shared secret. need rotation story.
rui: yep. proposal details: SDK options `postAuthRetryDelayMs` (default 100), `postAuthRetryJitterMs` (default 75), emit telemetry event `retry_after_auth_refresh` with hashed_body and attempt_idx, optional `enableTransientDedupe` (false by default) with TTL `transientDedupeMs=1500`. For signed idempotency: `enableSignedIdempotency=false`, `signedIdemAlgo=HMAC-SHA256`, `signedIdemTtlSec=30`, SDK uses client-side secret to sign body-hash|ts and sends headers `X-Idempotency-Key` + `X-Idem-Signature`.
micah: streaming/resume flows must be exempt from jitter/dedupe and never sign streaming frames.
hana: small implementation notes: signed idempotency must avoid leaking PII; SDK should sign only body-hash and include minimal metadata. server should only store signature metadata (or verify on each request) and reject duplicates within TTL.
rui: server prototype would accept signed idems for hosted customers only at first. For private deployments we can provide a script to configure verification keys. Rotation: rotate keys and accept previous key for grace window equal to signedIdemTtlSec.
micah: short-term action: I'll patch sampleapp to set a simple Idempotency-Key derived from user_id+body-hash and add a repro harness. medium-term: SDK PR for jitter + telemetry + optional signed idempotency + opt-in transient dedupe.
hana: add env flags for quick testing: `RW_SDK_POST_REFRESH_DELAY_MS`, `RW_SDK_POST_REFRESH_JITTER_MS`, `RW_SDK_ENABLE_SIGNED_IDEM`, `RW_SDK_SIGNED_IDEM_TTL`. defaults as above. keep streaming exempt.
rui: also include a diagnostic log line `retry_after_auth_refresh` so SRE/customers can trace when retries originated from auth refresh. that will help quantify the problem.
micah: good. SRE: please run the repro harness after PRs land. plan: 10k cycles with coordinated token expiry and assert duplicates << 1%.
rui: I'll prototype a tiny verifier for hosted and write up key management notes. hana: update onboarding docs: "If a request triggers external side-effects (webhooks, emails), set an Idempotency-Key or enable signed idempotency via SDK; client heuristics help but server-side dedupe is best."
devtools-bot: created issue #50123 "sdk: post-refresh jitter + optional signed idempotency header + telemetry to prevent duplicate accepts".
micah: I'll open the sampleapp PR and link #50123 with the repro script. thanks all :thumbsup:
